info.title: Pulsar API
info.description: Pulsar panel API. Browsers use the session cookie; state-changing requests then need the X-XSRF-TOKEN header with the token from the __Host-pulsar-xsrf cookie (pulsar-xsrf when Security:AllowInsecureHttp is on). Scripts use an API key created in the account page: `Authorization: Bearer pulsar_…`, no cookie and no antiforgery header. A key works on the operations that need a permission (with its user's permissions, or the ones it lists); never on /auth or /account.
